references.text: The misunderstanding of Jesus' words about rebuilding the temple in three days can be seen in light of David's son's zeal for the Lord's house, which prophetically points to Jesus' body as the true temple.
Daniel prophesied about a time when the earthly temple would be destroyed, providing background for Jesus' words about the temple's destruction and rebuilding.
Jesus' words about rebuilding the temple were wrongly used against him during the crucifixion, showing the misunderstanding of his message.
John explains that Jesus' words about rebuilding the temple actually referred to his body, offering insight into the deeper meaning behind his statement.
